verdict.rationale: Intuit publishes an official PHP SDK for the QuickBooks Online V3 REST API, with create, read, update and delete examples. It also publishes an official Node.js OAuth 2.0 client that handles token management and sandbox/production switching. The evidence shows only one full API SDK, plus an auth helper, so the breadth and depth of the SDK set are unproven. missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs across multiple languages (only PHP is shown as a full API SDK), in-depth SDK reference documentation, an official OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
